what: Seller describes using ChatGPT as a "creative partner" rather than a fully automated generator. Gave ChatGPT a specific directive to write 50 emotional journal prompts that help people heal from stress or heartbreak. Seller then added own stories, feelings, and reflections to the AI-generated content. Reports the result "didn't feel robotic."
verbatim_snippet: "Here's what I did — I turned ChatGPT into a creative partner. Instead of saying \"Write me an ebook,\" I said: \"Help me write 50 emotional journal prompts that help people heal from stress or heartbreak.\" Then I added my own stories, feelings, and reflections. The result didn't feel robotic — it felt real…"
notes: Member-only article; text visible through Medium free preview up to end of Step 2. Gumroad referenced in article intro ("What I did have was ChatGPT, Gumroad, and a desperate need to make something work online") and in the article title, but not in the cited snippet. Revenue claim of $10,000 in title is unverified and characteristic of Medium "make money online" genre; preserved only as secondary context. No Gumroad store URL provided. Author bio: "I'm Minakshi Jha, a storyteller of emotions, love, and struggles." Full production details beyond Step 2 are behind paywall.

extra_fields.product_type: Emotional journal prompts / digital writing prompts ebook
